description: This file manages task flow registry operations including creation, updating, deletion, and synchronization of task flow records, with support for persistence and observer notifications.

methods.name: cloneStructuredValue
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of a structured value if defined.

methods.name: cloneFlowRecord
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a TaskFlowRecord, cloning nested JSON fields.

methods.name: normalizeRestoredFlowRecord
methods.description: Normalizes a restored flow record, setting default values and ensuring data consistency.

methods.name: snapshotFlowRecords
methods.description: Converts a map of flow records into an array of cloned records.

methods.name: emitFlowRegistryObserverEvent
methods.description: Emits an event to all registered flow registry observers.

methods.name: ensureNotifyPolicy
methods.description: Returns a default notify policy if none is provided.

methods.name: normalizeOwnerKey
methods.description: Trims and normalizes an owner key string.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a string value.

methods.name: normalizeJsonBlob
methods.description: Normalizes a JSON value, cloning it if defined.

methods.name: assertFlowOwnerKey
methods.description: Ensures owner key is valid, throws error if not.

methods.name: assertControllerId
methods.description: Ensures controller ID is valid, throws error if not.

methods.name: resolveFlowGoal
methods.description: Determines the goal string for a task flow based on task label or task name.

methods.name: resolveFlowBlockedSummary
methods.description: Generates a blocked summary for a task if applicable.

methods.name: deriveTaskFlowStatusFromTask
methods.description: Derives the task flow status from a task's status and outcome.

methods.name: ensureFlowRegistryReady
methods.description: Restores the flow registry snapshot if not already attempted.

methods.name: getTaskFlowRegistryRestoreFailure
methods.description: Returns the failure message if restoring the registry failed.

methods.name: persistFlowRegistry
methods.description: Saves the current flow registry snapshot.

methods.name: persistFlowUpsert
methods.description: Upserts a flow record into the store.

methods.name: persistFlowDelete
methods.description: Deletes a flow record from the store.

methods.name: buildFlowRecord
methods.description: Constructs a new TaskFlowRecord with provided parameters.

methods.name: applyFlowPatch
methods.description: Applies a patch to an existing flow record, updating fields and revision.

methods.name: writeFlowRecord
methods.description: Stores and clones a flow record, emitting an event.

methods.name: createFlowRecord
methods.description: Creates and stores a new flow record.

methods.name: createManagedTaskFlow
methods.description: Creates a managed task flow with specified parameters.

methods.name: createTaskFlowForTask
methods.description: Creates a flow record for a specific task, deriving status and other info.

methods.name: updateFlowRecordByIdUnchecked
methods.description: Updates a flow record by ID without revision check.

methods.name: updateFlowRecordByIdExpectedRevision
methods.description: Updates a flow record by ID with revision check, returning success or conflict.

methods.name: setFlowWaiting
methods.description: Sets a flow's status to waiting or blocked with revision check.

methods.name: resumeFlow
methods.description: Resumes a flow, setting status to queued or running.

methods.name: finishFlow
methods.description: Marks a flow as succeeded and sets final state.

methods.name: failFlow
methods.description: Marks a flow as failed with optional final state.

methods.name: requestFlowCancel
methods.description: Requests cancellation of a flow.

methods.name: syncFlowFromTask
methods.description: Synchronizes a flow record from a task's current state.

methods.name: getTaskFlowById
methods.description: Retrieves a flow record by ID.

methods.name: listTaskFlowsForOwnerKey
methods.description: Lists all flows for a specific owner key, sorted by creation date.

methods.name: findLatestTaskFlowForOwnerKey
methods.description: Finds the latest flow for an owner key.

methods.name: resolveTaskFlowForLookupToken
methods.description: Resolves a flow record from a lookup token, by ID or owner key.

methods.name: listTaskFlowRecords
methods.description: Lists all flow records, sorted by creation date.

methods.name: deleteTaskFlowRecordById
methods.description: Deletes a flow record by ID.

methods.name: resetTaskFlowRegistryForTests
methods.description: Resets the flow registry state for testing purposes.
